expect: 交付的 `total_minutes()` 與 `by_worker()` 都對 — 也就是第五回合新開的那條路徑，仍然遵守第二與第三回合立下的規則

import csv, re
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open("events.csv",encoding="utf-8",newline="")))
print("rows:",len(rows))
print("fields:",rows[0].keys())
pat=re.compile(r"^\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$")
bad=[r for r in rows if not (pat.match(r["started_at"].strip()) and pat.match(r["ended_at"].strip()))]
print("bad time format:",len(bad), bad[:5])
ws=[r for r in rows if r["started_at"]!=r["started_at"].strip() or r["ended_at"]!=r["ended_at"].strip()]
print("whitespace rows:",len(ws))
def s(t):
    h,m,sec=map(int,t.strip().split(":")); return h*3600+m*60+sec
eq=[r for r in rows if s(r["started_at"])==s(r["ended_at"])]
print("zero/24h ambiguous:",len(eq))
wrap=[r for r in rows if s(r["ended_at"])<s(r["started_at"])]
print("wrap rows:",len(wrap))
blank=[r for r in rows if not r["worker"].strip()]
print("blank worker:",len(blank))
tot=sum((s(r["ended_at"])-s(r["started_at"]))%86400 for r in rows)
print("total seconds:",tot,"-> minutes floor:",tot//60)
naive=sum(s(r["ended_at"])-s(r["started_at"]) for r in rows)
print("naive (no wrap):",naive//60)

import report
rows = report.load_events()
lens = [(report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"]) - report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"])) % report.DAY_SECONDS for r in rows]
print("min per-event length (seconds):", min(lens))
print("negative count:", sum(1 for v in lens if v < 0))

# the wrap rows, and the same rows under a literal "+24h" rule
wrap = [(r, v) for r, v in zip(rows, lens)
        if report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"]) < report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"])]
print("wrap rows:", len(wrap))
for r, v in wrap[:3]:
    raw = report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"]) - report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"])
    print(f'  {r["worker"].strip() or "(blank)"} {r["started_at"].strip()}->{r["ended_at"].strip()}  '
          f'raw={raw}  modulo={v}  raw+86400={raw + report.DAY_SECONDS}')
print("modulo == raw+24h on every wrap row:",
      all(v == (report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"]) - report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"])) + report.DAY_SECONDS
          for r, v in wrap))

python3 - <<'PY'
import report
rows = report.load_events()
ws = [r for r in rows
      if r["started_at"] != r["started_at"].strip() or r["ended_at"] != r["ended_at"].strip()]
print("rows with padded time fields:", len(ws))
print("  ...of which blank worker (already excluded):",
      sum(1 for r in ws if not r["worker"].strip()))
for r in ws[:3]:
    print(f'  worker={r["worker"].strip()!r} start={r["started_at"]!r} end={r["ended_at"]!r} '
          f'-> {report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"])}, {report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"])}')

# every row parses without raising
bad = []
for r in rows:
    try:
        report._clock_seconds(r["started_at"]), report._clock_seconds(r["ended_at"])
    except Exception as exc:
        bad.append((r, exc))
print("rows that fail to parse:", len(bad))

# extra padding shapes, incl. tab / newline / internal spacing
for probe in ["  07:05:09  ", "\t07:05:09\n", " 7:5:9 "]:
    print(f"  {probe!r} -> {report._clock_seconds(probe)}")
print("total_minutes():", report.total_minutes())

    print(f"  {w}: {m}")
print("sum(by_worker):", sum(d.values()), " total_minutes():", report.total_minutes())
